Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2316; godless:--without God.
BiblicalUsage: Paul reminds the Gentile believers that they were once without Christ, aliens from Israel, strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope and without God in the world. The word is godless, and it describes a life with no share in Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that without God is the bleakest phrase in the Bible, and the wonder of the verse is the word that follows it in the next breath: but now in Christ Jesus.
